key_values.very_hot_dry_windy_definition: Tmax >= 45.0 C and precipitation < 1.0 mm and wind >= 30.0 km/h

primary_gt.computed_consequence: The threshold ledger supports a fire-weather-to-smoke cascade rather than a heat-only, rain/flood, or slow vegetation-change diagnosis.

criteria.description: Returns compact JSON with target_family, metrics, gates, answer, rejected_alternative, and one ledger-tied computed_consequence.
criteria.name: Requested JSON shape
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for minor key-name differences that preserve the same fields.

criteria.description: Reports longest_hot_dry_run_days = 15, longest_very_hot_dry_windy_run_days = 2, peak_tmax_c = 46.0, and sentinel2_dnbr_mean = 0.156 within tolerance.
criteria.name: Metric extraction
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for two or three correct metrics or recognizable threshold states.

criteria.description: Applies the hot-dry, very-hot-dry-windy, and burn-change threshold definitions exactly.
criteria.name: Predicate and formula use
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for correct qualitative gates with one threshold or inequality error.

criteria.description: Sets all five gates to true and returns compound_fire_weather_smoke_threshold_pass using the all-gates decision rule.
criteria.name: Gate ledger and final label
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for the correct label with one missing gate or correct gates with a mislabeled answer.

criteria.description: Treats pyrocumulonimbus or firestorm support and stratospheric-smoke support as narrative gates, not as values inferred from dNBR.
criteria.name: Text-gate separation
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for finding the right flags but blurring their source.

criteria.description: Rejects heat-only, rain/flood, or slow vegetation-change alternatives through the failed ledger logic.
criteria.name: Rejected alternative
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for rejecting one weaker alternative without tying it to a gate.

criteria.description: Keeps the final sentence tied to the threshold result and avoids extra loss totals, national representativeness claims, action claims, or broad disaster explanation.
criteria.name: Bounded computed consequence
criteria.partial_credit: No credit if the answer turns into an action note or broad disaster explanation.
